guidance.summary: Top-performing Shorts leverage clear stakes and direct viewer relevance paired with tangible, visual everyday topics like fireworks or PS5 hardware. Bottom-performing Shorts rely on abstract game-engine mechanics and weak metaphorical hooks that fail to retain viewers.
do: Frame hooks using direct personal stakes or provocative claims (e.g., 'Your console is secretly lying to your eyes')
Focus script concepts on tangible, real-world visual phenomena or recognizable consumer hardware
Keep overall video duration tightly under 50 seconds to support retention percentages
avoid: Avoid abstract, metaphorical 'counterintuitive' hooks like 'looks like a folded paper model' or 'train never hits those cars'
Stop picking backend video game development mechanics (e.g., collision physics, modding engines) as standalone topics
hook_guidance: Prioritize 'stakes' over abstract facts; explicitly state how the topic directly impacts the viewer or the immediate outcome
State a direct, concrete reality in the first 3 seconds rather than a figurative comparison
pacing_guidance: Aim for 46–49 seconds total length, as the channel's top video was under 47s while 52s+ videos suffered lower view percentages
topic_guidance: Pick real-world physical events (fireworks, sports ball physics) and flagship consumer tech (PS5 Pro)
Avoid deep-dive game engine simulations that lack a strong real-world anchor
